integration: These are reusable UI prefabs, not RuntimeSystems. Restore Profile and Common materials with their original GUIDs. Shared source lives in Systems/Common/UI and UI/VM; merge identical shared files instead of duplicating classes.

Bind each UIActivityEntry with one VMActivityEntry (OpenClick, Visible, Interactable, Badges). The host owns routing and data. The serialized id is a reference identifier; configure it for the product rather than depending on HomeEntry.

PlayerProfile embeds AvatarFrame. Bind its root entry and Avatar entry separately. PlayerName and Lv/Fitter/PlayerLevel are dynamic Text targets driven by host SyncText bindings, not automatically populated by the entry VM. Avatar/PlayerHeadImg and Avatar/PlayerFrameImg remain authored Image slots for product sprite binding.

Mail, Settings, Notice, Friends and Affinity each have an independent prefab. Retain their click areas and tip nodes. Register tip nodes with the product RedDotScope/configuration; do not hard-code Home red-dot IDs into these prefabs.

Bind each instance once and refresh its existing VM. Do not replace click callbacks: the current SyncClick appends listeners. Destroy/recreate after Unref. Optional NEW/ad visuals use existing serialized badge slots and the shared VM implementation.

Original native docking and sibling order are preserved. Browser cards normalize only the root for standalone preview. Home keeps TopLeft CanvasGroup/entrance animation; these components do not each replay a page entrance animation.

Upgrading existing Home: move UIActivityEntry, UIActivityBadge, their VMs, ActivityBadge and HomeTextOutline from Home to Common/UI, preserving .meta GUIDs. Move shared native resources using the included migration manifest before importing; do not leave duplicate GUIDs at old paths.
